messages:
sara: Quick FYI: q4b-v2 candidate brought up in staging is producing factual hallucinations on our news-summary golden set. ~0.9% of anchors have hallucinated facts that weren't present in source.
tomo: Do we know if this started after quantization tweaks or the prompt-template change?
esra: We changed both: int4 kernel update + new prompt-format that includes 'include_source: false' flag.
brad: I'm worried the prompt change suppressed the model's grounding. Can we A/B the prompts with the new quant?
sara: Plan: reproduce on golden -> collect failing seeds -> create a mini-label batch (golden_verif) for relabel/clarity.
tomo: Repro command: ```python -m ci.eval_golden --model q4b-v2 --subset news-summary --out /tmp/q4b_v2_fails.json```
labeler-bot: labeler-bot: created task LABEL-1429 for 150 examples in project "golden_verif" assigned to label-ops.
esra: Also run embedding similarity check vs baseline (q8b) to see if candidate generation changed. If embeddings drifted, some retrieved context may be different.
brad: If embedding drift shows up, we should run a dedupe + provenance check: fingerprint hashes and tokenization align.
sara: I'm going to seed a small golden patch: add 200 counterexamples where hallucinations are subtle (dates/places). We'll mark them with quality tag "halluc-check".
tomo: Budget note: labeling 200 x 3 judgments => ~600 microtasks. Ops: can we fast-track?
esra: I'll open RW-8399 to track the quant experiment and link LABEL-1429 and the mini-golden patch.
labeler-bot: labeler-bot: LABEL-1429 status set to "in progress" by label-ops at 6132201350.
sara: After labels land, we'll run eval: diff metric is hallucination_rate and factual_precision.
brad: Add a control: run same prompt-format with q8b baseline to check if prompt-format is culprit.
tomo: I'll run both tomorrow morning and post /artifacts/q4b-v2-golden-diff.json
esra: Thx. If we confirm quant is the root cause, we may need to adjust kernels or fallback to q8b for the news domain.
sara: Tagging @label-ops and @infra for visibility. I'll update RW-8399 with timeline.
labeler-bot: labeler-bot: LABEL-1429 completed (150/150) at 6132201390. Results pushed to s3://golden-verif/q4b_v2/labels.json
esra: Got labels, starting eval now. Will post summary in thread.
